  Scenario: AC4 Each business rule BR1 to BR12 of section 8 holds (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR12 of section 8
    When the mapping is read, changed or used at sign-in
    Then each rule holds as section 8 states it and no rule is changed

  Scenario: AC5 A caller without a role or letter is refused with 401 or 403 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller with no Workbench role and a caller without the letter of the operation
    When each calls a provided operation
    Then the caller with no role gets 401 with MSG-P4-001, the caller without the letter gets 403 with MSG-P4-002, and the 404 answer is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-AD001-APP-AC5)

  Scenario: AC6 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write has been made with an idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again with the same key
    Then Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-AD001-APP-AC6)

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call to the parameters contract, the decision-record library or the ACE view fails or does not answer
    When the change or the sign-in needs that call
    Then Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-AD001-APP-AC7)

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a status change that the status values of LOV-VERSION-STATUS do not allow
    When the change is asked
    Then Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-AD001-APP-AC8)
